official.status_note: The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, with the Central Bank of Egypt, extended the 2026/2027 application period to 19:00 on Friday 4 September 2026; that cycle has closed and the next call is expected in the same late-August window.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Ministry states the scholarship includes "full coverage of study expenses" together with accommodation and living costs at participating national universities for the whole period of study until graduation, conditional on the student continuing to meet the scholarship's requirements.
benefits: Living and board costs covered for the duration of study at participating national universities until graduation
Coverage continues provided the student continues to meet the scholarship's requirements
eligibility: Holder of a secondary school certificate from a government school for the 2025/2026 academic year
Beneficiary of the Takaful wa-Karama initiative, or exempted from school fees by the Ministry of Education during the 2025/2026 academic year
Not dismissed academically or disciplinarily from any educational institution
Not already in receipt of another scholarship funded by another party in parallel with this scholarship
requirements: Preliminary shortlisting is done electronically on the basis of the secondary school total score
Geographic distribution applies: allocation by the governorate where the secondary school is located, or the nearest governorate if the requested faculty is not available there
An admission test is held after preliminary shortlisting; only candidates who pass are shortlisted to complete the scholarship admission procedures
The applicant signs an application undertaking together with the parent or guardian
Log in to the official portal using the national ID number as the username and the password printed on the secondary school completion certificate
documents: All documents required by the application portal, uploaded electronically
Signed application undertaking from the student and the parent or guardian
selection_criteria: Candidates are sorted electronically according to their secondary school total mark to select preliminary candidates, applying the geographic distribution of scholarships across all governorates
An admission test is run after preliminary shortlisting, and only candidates who pass the test are shortlisted for the scholarship admission procedure
coverage: Living and board costs, for the whole period of study at participating national universities until graduation
application_method: Apply online through the official Future Scientists Scholarship portal at https://futurescholars.mohesr.gov.eg/
Log in with the national ID number as the username and the password printed on the secondary school completion certificate
Upload all required documents and sign the student and parent undertaking
official.application_route: Single online application on the ministry's dedicated portal, logging in with the national ID and the password printed on the secondary school completion certificate
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Nine designated specialisms: medicine, engineering, computers and artificial intelligence, nursing, veterinary medicine, applied arts, arts and design, agriculture, and tourism, hotels and antiquities
official.duration: Until graduation from the participating national university
official.description: A fully funded Egyptian government scholarship awarded by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research in cooperation with the Central Bank of Egypt, for academically distinguished 2025/2026 government-school leavers who are Takaful wa-Karama beneficiaries or were exempted from school fees, joining participating national universities in nine state-priority specialisms with study, accommodation and living costs covered until graduation.

verification.notes: The State Information Service's official news page (1 September 2026) publishes the ministry's extension notice in full, including the 4 September 2026 19:00 deadline, the coverage wording, the nine specialisms and the portal link; the portal itself returned a transport error on 2026-10-10. No monetary figure is published.

applicant_utility.summary: Eligibility is narrower than the headline suggests: you must be a 2025/2026 government-school leaver with top marks and already inside the social-protection net as a Takaful wa-Karama beneficiary or a Ministry of Education fee-exempted student. If you qualify, the work is compressed into a very short electronic window - the 2026/27 round was extended by only about two days - so have your national ID and secondary certificate in hand before it opens.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving Egyptian secondary school leavers from low-income households already covered by Takaful wa-Karama or by a Ministry of Education fee exemption.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you appear as a Takaful wa-Karama beneficiary or hold a Ministry of Education fee exemption covering 2025/2026
Locate your secondary school completion certificate - its printed password is your portal login
Check which of the nine specialisms your preferred faculty falls under, since placement is geographic
Prepare the student and parent/guardian undertaking signature in advance
Be ready to sit the admission test shortly after the mark-based preliminary shortlisting
common_rejection_risks: Holding any other scholarship funded by another party in parallel, which is expressly barred
A prior academic or disciplinary dismissal from any educational institution
Applying for a faculty outside the nine designated specialisms
Failing the admission test that follows the preliminary shortlisting on secondary-school totals
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The Ministry publishes no travel or personal-cost allowance, so transport, clothing, a laptop and personal spending in the governorate of study should be assumed to be self-funded.
document_audit: The portal username is the national ID number and the password is printed on the secondary completion certificate - losing the certificate blocks access
The undertaking must be signed by both the student and the parent or guardian
Everything is uploaded electronically; no paper file is described
alerts: Allocation is geographic: you are placed by the governorate of your secondary school, or the nearest governorate if your requested faculty is not available there
Coverage lasts only while you continue to meet the scholarship's requirements, so academic performance after admission keeps the award alive
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Enter the portal with your national ID and certificate password, complete the electronic file, sign the undertaking, then sit the admission test if shortlisted on marks.
